title: Component identification of modified sanmiao pills by UPLC-Xevo G2-XS QTOF and its anti-gouty arthritis mechanism based on network pharmacology and experimental verification.
authors: Chen, Ruyi; Li, Fenfen; Zhou, Kai; Xing, Mengyu; Zhang, Xiaoxi; Zhao, Xinyu; Wu, Chenxi; Han, Ziwei; Zhou, Yixuan; Yan, Li; Xia, Daozong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方治疗痛风性关节炎，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Modified sanmiao pills (MSMP), a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula, is consisted of rhizome of Smilax glabra Roxb., Cortexes of Phellodendron chinensis Schneid., rhizome of Atractylodes chinensis (DC.) Koidz., and roots of Cyathula officinalis Kuan. in a ratio of 3:3:2:1. This formula has been broadly applied to treat gouty arthritis (GA) in China. AIMS OF THE STUDY: To elaborate the pharmacodynamic material basis and pharmacological mechanism of MSMP against GA. MATERIALS AND METHODS: UPLC-Xevo G2-XS QTOF combined with UNIFI platform was applied to qualitatively assess the chemical compounds of MSMP. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to identify the active compounds, core targets and key pathways of MSMP against GA. The GA mice model was established by MSU suspension injecting into ankle joint. The swelling index of ankle joint, expressions of inflammatory cytokines, and histopathological changes in mice ankle joints were determined to validate the therapeutic effect of MSMP against GA. The protein expressions of TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome in vivo was detected by Western blotting. RESULTS: In total, 34 chemical compounds and 302 potential targets of MSMP were ascertained, of which 28 were overlapping targets pertaining to GA. 143 KEGG enrichment pathway were obtained, of which the NOD-like receptor signaling pathway, Toll-like receptor signaling pathway, and NF-kappaB signaling pathway were strongly associated with GA. In silico study indicated that the active compounds had excellent binding affinity to core targets. In vivo study confirmed that MSMP observably decreased swelling index and alleviated pathological damage to ankle joints in acute GA mice. Besides, MSMP significantly inhibited the secretion of inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha) induced by MSU, as well as the expression levels of key proteins involved in TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome. CONCLUSION: MSMP possessed a pronounced therapeutic effect on acute GA. Results from network pharmacology and molecular docking showed that obaculactone, oxyberberine, and neoisoastilbin might treat gouty arthritis by down-regulating TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：改良三妙丸（MSMP）是一种传统中药（TCM）方剂，由光叶菝葜（Smilax glabra Roxb.）根茎、黄柏（Phellodendron chinensis Schneid.）树皮、苍术（Atractylodes chinensis (DC.) Koidz.）根茎和川牛膝（Cyathula officinalis Kuan.）根以3:3:2:1的比例组成。该方剂在中国已被广泛用于治疗痛风性关节炎（GA）。研究目的：阐明MSMP抗GA的药效物质基础及药理机制。材料与方法：采用UPLC-Xevo G2-XS QTOF结合UNIFI平台对MSMP的化学成分进行定性评估。利用网络药理学和分子对接技术鉴定MSMP抗GA的活性化合物、核心靶点和关键通路。通过将MSU混悬液注射入踝关节建立GA小鼠模型。测定小鼠踝关节肿胀指数、炎症细胞因子表达及踝关节组织病理学变化，以验证MSMP对GA的治疗效果。通过Western blotting检测体内TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路及NLRP3炎症小体的蛋白表达。结果：共鉴定出MSMP的34种化学成分和302个潜在靶点，其中28个为与GA相关的重叠靶点。获得143条KEGG富集通路，其中NOD样受体信号通路、Toll样受体信号通路和NF-kappaB信号通路与GA密切相关。计算机模拟研究表明，活性化合物与核心靶点具有优异的结合亲和力。体内研究证实，MSMP显著降低急性GA小鼠的肿胀指数并减轻踝关节病理损伤。此外，MSMP显著抑制MSU诱导的炎症细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）分泌，以及TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路和NLRP3炎症小体中关键蛋白的表达水平。结论：MSMP对急性GA具有显著的治疗效果。网络药理学和分子对接结果表明，黄柏内酯（obaculactone）、氧小檗碱（oxyberberine）和新异落新妇苷（neoisoastilbin）可能通过下调TLRs/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路和NLRP3炎症小体来治疗痛风性关节炎。
